thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed a couple of v2 migration snippets that will break TypeScript users. planning a tiny docs PR today.
jamal: which snippets? can you paste the lines?
maya: the quickstart example still uses `client.models.list()` and the old `X-Redwood-Key` header. v2 expects `client.generate()` + standard Authorization header. found in /docs/migrations/v1-to-v2.md around the 'model' section.
li_chen: ahhh thanks. that's the one folks hit when they upgrade. do you have a fix suggestion?
maya: propose replacing the snippet with:
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: "redwood-1.0", input: "hello" });
```
and update the note about headers to show `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and remove the old header example.
noah: also saw a broken internal link to the SDK auth page (404) from that migration page. PR should update the anchor to `#auth-and-headers` not `#auth`.
jamal: ok please open a PR and drop the link here. I can review and merge if tests pass.
maya: raised PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4689 — includes snippet update, anchor fix, and a tiny note about model aliasing for customers who used `modelId` in v1.
li_chen: nice. docs-bot, run snippet-compile check please?
docs-bot: snippet-linter: running for PR #4689 — TypeScript check failed: missing import for Redwood in quickstart.ts snippet.
maya: will add the import and push.
maya: updated — added `import Redwood from "@redwood/inference";` and added a comment about model alias map. pushed to PR.
noah: can we add a one-liner in the changelog about deprecated `listModels()` -> replaced by catalog lookups? ops teams keep asking about model discovery changes.
jamal: good call. add a short bullet under Migration notes — "listModels() deprecated; use catalog reference + generate() model name". keep it brief.
li_chen: once merged can we cherry-pick to `stable-docs` branch? some enterprise customers track that branch.
maya: yep, will do after merge. tagging you, @li_chen for follow-up on the customer-facing email draft.
jamal: LGTM on approach. after merge I'll trigger the docs deploy. leave a note in release notes. :rocket:
maya: thanks all — I left a manual test checklist in the PR description (quickstart run, link check, snippet compile). ping me if anything else pops up.
noah: thanks maya. small but high impact.
docs-bot: PR #4689 merged by jamal — deploy queued."
